issues: Minimum story count not previously met; now resolved
notes: Expanded to full story set covering schema, core logic, API integration, testing, and end-to-end validation.

stories.title: Allowlist Enforcement Core Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement core routing logic that strictly enforces an allowlist of approved tools, rejecting any tool_use requests not explicitly registered, and safely dispatching validated requests to corresponding handlers.

stories.title: Pydantic Validation Execution per Tool
stories.description: Integrate Pydantic model validation into the routing pipeline so that each tool invocation validates inputs against its defined schema before execution, with strict failure handling.

stories.title: Agent Loop Integration for Tool Dispatch
stories.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI agent loop, ensuring tool_use blocks from the LLM are correctly intercepted, routed via allowlist, and responses injected back into the conversation flow.

stories.title: Unit and Negative Testing for Tool Router
stories.description: Develop comprehensive unit tests for tool routing, including allowlist acceptance, rejection of unauthorized tools, Pydantic validation failures, and malformed tool_use payloads.

stories.title: End-to-End Tool Invocation Validation
stories.description: Validate full tool invocation flow from LLM-generated tool_use through router dispatch to domain service execution and response return, ensuring consistency with chat history injection and system prompts.

per_feature.mitigation: Strict allowlist enforcement and existing unit tests prevent unauthorized tool execution.
